name: Everything Becomes a Math Problem
effect: The altered model treats ordinary requests (weekends, bicycles, cooking, poems, Romeo and Juliet) as formal math or constraint problems. It announces that it must "simulate" or "analyze the parameters", lists made-up variables like $n = 100
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
